title: Tianji Breaking Formation
next_chapter_hook: Ling Yuan's figure descended from the heavens like a specter, an overwhelming pressure instantly engulfing the entire arena. Chen Ji's pupils constricted—he knew the true test of life and death had just begun.

text.content:
The lingering fragrance of that elixir still danced on his taste buds, yet an icy chill spread through Chen Ji's heart—the seven-day deadline was just around the corner, when he would face another life-or-death choice. But for now, he had to suppress this anxiety deep within and focus entirely on the predicament before him.

A massive golden net formed by the Five Elders' combined Formation enveloped the entire Martial Arena. At its center, five figures stood proudly—each one the most senior elder of the Tianqing Sect, each possessing late Golden Core cultivation. Together, they had constructed an impenetrable Formation.

Chen Ji stood at the Formation's edge, his surface demeanor one of fearful unease, while his mind raced at lightning speed. He could sense the Tianji Record trembling gently within his Mental Sea, that familiar power stirring with restless anticipation.

The fourth level of the Tianji Record... he hadn't touched this threshold in a very long time. Since last time he risked using the Tianji Record to foresee the future, his Heavenly Fate Value had been consumed by more than half. Were it not for that elixir temporarily stabilizing his foundation, he wouldn't have been able to sustain this dangerous gamble.

dialogue.content:
Waste, what are you still waiting for?

Ling Yuan's voice rang out from among the Five Elders, carrying undisguised contempt. He stood at the Formation's very core, white hair dancing in the wind, his gaze fixed on Chen Ji as if observing a lamb awaiting slaughter.

I grant you the time of a single incense stick. If you cannot break this Formation, you will leave the Tianqing Sect and never return to the Mountain Gate!

text.content:
Chen Ji lowered his head, yet the corner of his lips curved upward slightly. What he had been waiting for was precisely these words.

The time of one incense stick was more than enough for him.

Slowly closing his eyes, the Tianji Record Fragment within his Mental Sea suddenly blazed with brilliant light. The fourth-level ability—Formation Analysis—was awakening!

In an instant, Chen Ji's vision underwent a dramatic transformation. The seemingly impenetrable Five Elders' combined Formation appeared to him as a dense network of lines. Every node and Formation Rune was clearly visible within his mind's eye.

He could see it.

The entire Formation's core rested on five support points, each sustained by an elder's True Qi. By severing the connections between any three support points, the Formation would collapse on its own. Among these points, the most vulnerable node lay on the northeastern Formation wall.

However, as Chen Ji probed that node with his divine sense, his brow furrowed slightly.

The node's defense was unexpectedly weak, almost like a deliberate gap. This felt wrong.

His intuition screamed warnings—this was a trap. Among the Five Elders, someone must have anticipated his Formation-breaking abilities and deliberately left this bait, waiting for him to take the hook.

choice.prompt: Formation Analysis was complete, but Chen Ji discovered a dangerous trap. He must make a choice:

choices.description: Charging straight into the known trap, using the Tianji Record's Foresight Ability to find the solution before the trap triggers. Extremely high risk, but if successful, it will shatter the Five Elders' confidence in one stroke.
choices.visible_reward: Break three nodes at once, shocking the entire arena
choices.risk_hint: If failed, will expose part of the Tianji Record's abilities

text.content:
The corner of Chen Ji's lips curved into a cold smirk. What he excelled at most was finding生机 in desperate situations.

Knowing the mountain has tigers, he would proceed anyway—this was his style.

His eyes snapped open, and brilliant golden light suddenly burst from his pupils. The Tianji Record's power instantly flooded his vision, revealing every detail of that trap node with perfect clarity.

choices.description: Ignoring the trap node, searching for Formation-breaking methods simultaneously from the other four directions. Though time-consuming, it has the advantage of being safe and won't expose too much strength.
choices.visible_reward: Gradually dismantle the Formation, conceal true strength
choices.risk_hint: May be perceived by the Five Elders as deliberately holding back

text.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath, suppressing the冲动 within his heart.

Playing the pig to devour the tiger—this had always been his style. Before fully understanding the enemy's hidden cards, rashly exposing all his strength was the stupidest choice.

He maintained his expression of fearful unease while secretly probing the Formation's other directions with his divine sense, searching for a truly safe path to break the Formation.

Regardless of which choice was made, Chen Ji's movements were completed in the span of lightning.

His form blurred, transforming into a fading afterimage as he rushed directly toward the Formation's northeastern wall. That speed was astonishing, causing several of the Five Elders to slightly change expression.

The moment before Chen Ji was about to touch the Formation wall, the trap was triggered!

A razor-sharp sword energy erupted from the Formation wall's depths, shooting directly at Chen Ji's Brow Center. The power contained within that sword energy far exceeded the Golden Core stage, nearly reaching the Nascent Soul level!

Satisfied smiles appeared on the Five Elders' faces. This waste had indeed taken the bait.

However, the corner of Chen Ji's lips curved into a mocking arc.

In that final moment before the sword energy touched his Brow Center, his body twisted impossibly, dodging this lethal strike through an incredible maneuver. Simultaneously, his finger landed precisely on an unremarkable spot on the Formation wall.

This was the spot!

BOOM!

A thunderous roar echoed from the depths of the Formation wall. The spot Chen Ji had struck suddenly blazed with blinding white light, and immediately, the entire northeast corner of the Formation began violent trembling.

The first node collapsed!

dialogue.content: What?! Chen Ji's face changed dramatically, his eyes filled with disbelief. He had personally witnessed Chen Ji see through that trap, and not only that, but in an instant found the true weakness behind it. How could this废物 do such a thing?!

text.content: Chen Ji gave the Five Elders no time to react. The Tianji Record's analytical ability continued to operate at high speed, his eyes constantly scanning through the formation, firmly remembering the position of each node. The second node, southwest direction, Wu position! His figure transformed into afterimages once more, rushing toward the next target.

The Five Elders finally reacted, all rushing to mobilize their true essence to try to repair the formation. However, how could their speed compare to Chen Ji's? The second node, collapsed! Then came the third node! When Chen Ji shattered the final node in the southeast direction with a palm strike, the entire Five Elders Combined Formation collapsed thunderously! Golden light scattered, five figures stumbled backward, utterly disheveled.

choice.prompt: The formation was broken, but the Five Elders' dignity would never allow them to simply let it go. At this moment, Ling Yuan's face turned frightfully gloomy—

choices.description: While the Five Elders were still unsteady, continue to provoke them with words, completely destroying their psychological defense. The risk is that it might provoke Ling Yuan to act prematurely.
choices.visible_cost: May provoke Ling Yuan to act
choices.visible_reward: Greatly increase reputation, leaving the Five Elders utterly humiliated

dialogue.content: Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, surveying his surroundings, a faint sneer on his face. Is this the strength of the Tianqing Sect's Five Elders? This junior thought you would be formidable, but turns out you're nothing special after all. His voice wasn't loud, yet it clearly reached everyone's ears. The Five Elders' faces instantly flushed to the color of pig liver, yet they had nothing to say in response.

choices.text: Know when to cash in one's gains
choices.description: The formation is broken, the objective has been achieved. Stop provoking, turn and leave, giving both sides a way to preserve face.
choices.visible_cost: Lose the opportunity to intimidate the Five Elders
choices.visible_reward: Maintain a low-profile persona, avoid exposing strength too early
choices.risk_hint: May be perceived as humiliation by the Five Elders

text.content: Chen Ji smiled faintly, withdrawing his gaze. He was not someone who didn't know when to cash in his gains. Today he had already shown too much; if he continued to provoke, it would only give Ling Yuan an excuse to act. He straightened his robes, clasped his hands toward the Five Elders in a formal bow, and turned to leave.

However, Chen Ji had only taken two steps when a suffocating pressure descended from the heavens. His footsteps abruptly stopped, a hint of solemnity flickering in his eyes. This pressure... it's too strong!

dialogue.content: Stop. Ling Yuan's voice was like the cold ice of the Nine Abysses, ice-cold without a trace of emotion. He slowly walked toward Chen Ji, with each step the pressure in the air grew heavier. This old man wants to see exactly what ability this废物 possesses to actually break our Five Elders Formation!

text.content: Chen Ji slowly turned around to face this old master of the Tianqing Sect. He knew the real test was just beginning. Ling Yuan's strength was nowhere near comparable to the Five Elders—he was a Half-Step Nascent Soul existence. With his current cultivation, a direct confrontation would be no different from an egg striking a rock. But he was not flustered. Because he still had the Tianji Record.

Ling Yuan's pressure was like a solidified mountain, crushing down on Chen Ji layer upon layer. His robes fluttered violently, the surrounding air twisted by this pressure. Yet Chen Ji stood firmly in place, even a faint smile playing at the corners of his lips. He stared directly into Ling Yuan's eyes, speaking calmly: Sect Master Ancestor, are you personally going to make a move? This sentence appeared respectful on the surface, but actually contained hidden daggers. If Ling Yuan truly struck at this moment, word would spread that an old senior of Half-Step Nascent Soul was bullying a servant disciple—where would the Tianqing Sect's face go?

Ling Yuan's face changed slightly, clearly also realizing this point. But he was a crafty old fox, and immediately found a countermeasure. He sneered coldly, withdrawing some of the pressure, yet still keeping Chen Ji within his imposing presence. This old man will not bully the small with the large. However... A ruthless glint flashed in his eyes. Since you can break the Five Elders Formation, you must possess considerable strength. In three days, the Sect Tournament will begin. This old man wants to see what storms this废物 can stir up before everyone's eyes! With that, he swept his sleeve and left, leaving behind a meaningful silhouette. The three-day deadline... Chen Ji gazed in the direction Ling Yuan departed, a solemn gleam flickering in his eyes. In three days, the Sect Tournament would commence. And the secret of the Tianji Record on his body seemed increasingly difficult to hide.
